target_customer: Private equity firms, limited partners and other investors that need to find and research private companies and firms
problem: Finding private equity firms and private companies takes manual work across scattered sources. Capix aggregates and enriches data into one customizable platform, later an AI sourcing copilot.
business_model: B2B SaaS, private beta with demo requests; pricing not found
product_category: AI data and sourcing platform for private capital

founders.name: Bruno Jacob
founders.background_notes: YC page names him as co-founder with no education or employers listed; no other founder named in sources.

competitors.name: Grata
competitors.what: Search engine for private companies used by private equity firms for deal sourcing
competitors.traction_then: Said it had grown over 8x since January 2021
competitors.funding_then: 25M USD Series A in Feb 2022, 35M total

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating and enriching data from many sources into a searchable platform is standard data engineering with entity resolution challenges; AI agent features arrived later.

defensibility.rationale: Funded incumbents such as Grata already had data and customers, and aggregated public data is copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Per a 2026 comparison site, Datasite acquired Grata and SourceScrub in 2025, consolidating the category; Capix itself was not found acquired.

market_need_then: Private equity firms already paid for deal sourcing and private company data tools in 2022, as Grata's Series A and growth claims show; no Capix-specific demand evidence was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses capix.ai; YC directory slug is capix with capixai also seen.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand was found, and the name is easily confused with Capsa AI, Capx AI and other similar names.

pivots.from: PE firm discovery data platform (YC page)
pivots.to: Autonomous sourcing copilot for companies and people (site, 2024 copyright)
pivots.why: not stated; date of the shift is unknown

outcome_analysis: Capix is a YC Summer 2022 company with one named founder that moved from a private equity data platform toward an AI sourcing copilot, still in private beta in 2024 per its site. No priced rounds, customers or press were found, and funded rivals like Grata were consolidating, so the outcome is unclear.
notes: CB Insights lists a convertible note and 500K USD total raised with YC, Canary VC and Demo Day as investors; a single aggregator listing with an unclear date, so unverified and not recorded as a round. No cross-check found. Acquisition dates for Grata and SourceScrub come from 2026 comparison pages and are unverified. Many similar names (Capsa AI, Capx AI) appear in searches and were excluded. Founder background is null because no source opened gave it. The site copyright reads 2024, so the 2026 status is uncertain.
